cards.example_es: Existe la teoría de que hay vida en Marte.
cards.example_en: There's a theory that there's life on Mars.

cards.example_es: Algunos científicos sostienen que es posible.
cards.example_en: Some scientists maintain that it's possible.

cards.example_es: El testigo afirma que vio una luz.
cards.example_en: The witness claims he saw a light.

cards.example_es: Tuve la premonición de que algo iba a pasar.
cards.example_en: I had a premonition that something was going to happen.

cards.example_es: ¿Crees en la telepatía?
cards.example_en: Do you believe in telepathy?

cards.example_es: Anoche tuve una pesadilla horrible.
cards.example_en: Last night I had a horrible nightmare.

cards.example_es: Tengo el presentimiento de que vas a aprobar.
cards.example_en: I have a feeling you're going to pass.

cards.example_es: Dicen que hay un fantasma en el castillo.
cards.example_en: They say there's a ghost in the castle.

cards.example_es: Varios vecinos dicen que vieron un ovni.
cards.example_en: Several neighbours say they saw a UFO.

cards.example_es: En la casa abandonada se oyen voces.
cards.example_en: You can hear voices in the abandoned house.

cards.example_es: Si pudieras viajar en el tiempo, ¿adónde irías?
cards.example_en: If you could travel in time, where would you go?

cards.example_es: Parece que me lees el pensamiento.
cards.example_en: It's as if you can read my mind.

cards.example_es: Al entrar noté una presencia extraña.
cards.example_en: When I went in I sensed a strange presence.

cards.example_es: Fue una desaparición muy misteriosa.
cards.example_en: It was a very mysterious disappearance.

cards.example_es: Es asombroso lo que hace este mago.
cards.example_en: What this magician does is amazing.

cards.example_es: Pasó algo inexplicable aquella noche.
cards.example_en: Something inexplicable happened that night.

cards.example_es: Las líneas de Nazca son impresionantes.
cards.example_en: The Nazca lines are impressive.

cards.example_es: Mi abuela cree en el destino.
cards.example_en: My grandmother believes in fate.

cards.example_es: No me creo nada de lo que dice.
cards.example_en: I don't believe anything he says.

cards.example_es: Siempre pienso en ti.
cards.example_en: I'm always thinking about you.

cards.example_es: ¿Qué piensas de esta teoría?
cards.example_en: What do you think of this theory?

cards.example_es: ¿Te acuerdas de aquel verano?
cards.example_en: Do you remember that summer?

cards.example_es: Este pueblo me recuerda a mi infancia.
cards.example_en: This village reminds me of my childhood.

cards.example_es: Estoy convencida de que tiene razón.
cards.example_en: I'm convinced she's right.

cards.example_es: A lo mejor ha perdido el móvil.
cards.example_en: Maybe he's lost his phone.

cards.example_es: Puede que llegue tarde.
cards.example_en: He may arrive late.

cards.example_es: Igual nos vemos en la fiesta.
cards.example_en: Maybe we'll see each other at the party.

cards.example_es: ¡Qué casualidad verte aquí!
cards.example_en: What a coincidence seeing you here!

cards.example_es: La muerte del faraón sigue siendo un enigma.
cards.example_en: The pharaoh's death is still a mystery.

cards.example_es: Recientes investigaciones sugieren que es falso.
cards.example_en: Recent research suggests it's false.
